review_notes:
I reviewed every declaration in the file: factorRadiusLevel and its nonnegativity and monotonicity lemmas, actualFactorStops, the factorSwitchList lemmas, actualFactorStops_regular, LocalizedState.actual_at, actual_phase_regulator and actual_phase_switch_clock. I read the lemmas they rely on: radiusLevelTime_mono, cutoffStop, cutoffStop_coe, cutoffStop_mono, cutoffStop_stopping, cutoff_radius_eq_iff, cutoff_radius_factor_thresholds, phaseAt, phaseAt_active_iff, phaseAt_regulator_eq_and_le_one and the LocalizedState structure. I also read the callers in MultipointActualProbability, MultipointActualExpectation, MultipointActualCutoffs and MultipointActualBudget.

The factorRadiusLevel lemmas already have minimal hypotheses. Both nonnegativity assumptions are needed, at k = 0 and k = 2.

The factorSwitchList lemmas never use the product structure of `ι × Fin 3`, so they could be stated for any Fintype index. Every use has this product type, so the gain would be minor and I did not report it.

LocalizedState.actual_at needs `[Fintype ι]` only because the structure itself requires it.

The finding about actual_phase_regulator and actual_phase_switch_clock is a consequence of the main finding. Their `horder` argument becomes derivable from hypotheses they already have (hBc, hw, h₀, hu). Removing it outright would belong to the separate unnecessary-hypotheses experiment, so I only mention it as a downstream benefit. I have not compiled the proposed lemma.

findings.problem: This theorem combines three facts that need very different assumptions. Only the stopping-time part needs the Brownian and measurability hypotheses: hB, hm, hBm, hB0, hκ, hκ8 and hz, used through actual_radiusLevelTime_stopping. The monotonicity part is proved only from pathwise continuity (hBc), the capacity witness (hw), h₀ and hu, via cutoffStop_mono and radiusLevelTime_mono. The horizon bound needs no hypotheses at all. As written, a user who wants monotonicity or the bound for a single path must still supply a Brownian motion, measurability, κ < 8 and points in the upper half-plane. This already happens in MultipointActualProbability, which calls the theorem only to project `.2.1`.
findings.proposed_change:
Split out a pathwise lemma under the weaker hypotheses and derive the old conjunction from it:
```lean
lemma actualFactorStops_monotone {Ω ι : Type*} {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}
    (hBc : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => B t ω)) {κ : ℝ}
    {γ : Ω → ℝ≥0 → ℂ} {G F : Ω → ℝ≥0 → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hw : ∀ ω, IsCapacityTwoWitness (fun t => Real.sqrt κ*B t ω) (γ ω) (G ω) (F ω))
    (z : ι → ℂ) {u₀ u₂ : ι → ℝ} (h₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u₀ i) (hu : ∀ i, u₀ i ≤ u₂ i)
    (H : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) (i : ι) :
    Monotone (fun k => actualFactorStops γ G z u₀ u₂ H (i,k) ω) := by
  intro j k hjk
  apply cutoffStop_mono _ (H+1) ω
  intro ω'
  exact radiusLevelTime_mono (continuous_const.mul (hBc ω')) (hw ω') (z i)
    (factorRadiusLevel_nonneg (h₀ i) ((h₀ i).trans (hu i)) j)
    (factorRadiusLevel_monotone (hu i) hjk)
```
The body is the existing second bullet of the proof. Also add `actualFactorStops_le (k ω) : actualFactorStops γ G z u₀ u₂ H k ω ≤ H+1 := cutoffStop_le_horizon _ _ ω`, with no hypotheses. Keep actualFactorStops_regular for the stopping-time part, or rebuild its conjunction from these two lemmas.
findings.benefit: Monotonicity of the three radius stops can then be used for any continuous driving path with a capacity witness, without a probabilistic setup. Downstream, MultipointActualProbability (`.2.1`) and the `horder` arguments of actual_phase_regulator and actual_phase_switch_clock can be discharged directly from hBc, hw, h₀ and hu, which those theorems already take. The statement also makes clear which assumptions each property really needs.
